name: Robotics Kinematics: Armeline
subtitle: Robotics Kinematics Labs
shortDescription: Adaptive robotics kinematics course: arm frames, inverse kinematics, rover pursuit, joint move profiles and gimbal lock in five 3D labs. Study aid only.
longDescription:
Robotics Kinematics: Armeline teaches how robots move by starting from a real machine and letting the mathematics follow. It is for study only and is not for real robot design, commissioning or safety decisions.

### Five 3D Labs
- Frame Forge: a six-joint bench arm picking parts from a tray. Move each joint and watch the Denavit-Hartenberg frames carry the tool tip while the pose matrix updates live.
- Reach Atlas: drag a target and let damped least-squares inverse kinematics chase it. The reachable workspace is coloured by manipulability, and a velocity ellipsoid from the Jacobian changes colour and pulses as the arm nears a singularity.
- Rover Track: a warehouse rover follows a painted lane by pure pursuit. Switch between differential drive and Ackermann steering, change the lookahead, and read curvature, wheel speeds and cross-track error.
- Move Profiles: cubic, quintic and trapezoid joint motion with position, speed and acceleration traces beside the moving arm.
- Spin Lab: a three-ring gimbal that locks at 90 degrees of pitch, and quaternion slerp compared with Euler-angle interpolation.
Every formula is cited and every number is cross-checked.

### Learn Your Way
- Choose the length of every quiz: 5, 10, 20, 40 or your own number.
- Choose the level, from beginner to research-level, or follow the course order, or let adaptive practice pick the next item.
- 136 items across 14 topics; numeric answers are generated from the same formulas the labs use and re-derived by an independent method.
- A timed mock exam that never shows ads, mastery by topic and a review queue, and text size controls on every screen.

### Sources You Can Open
Every lab has a Sources button that opens the cited textbook or paper page inside the app. Citations are links only.

### Free With Optional Ad-Free Plan
Free and works offline. Ads appear only at natural breaks, never in a mock exam. An optional monthly subscription removes ads, and one video pauses ads for an hour.
